name: io.github.ghstaking/bentcrypto-mcp
description: MCP bridge for BentCrypto x402 Token Risk on Solana/Base and Token Security on Solana, with local wallet signing and spend controls.

tools.name: discover_bentcrypto
tools.description: Free discovery of BentCrypto x402 capabilities and pricing.

tools.name: preview_token_risk_payment
tools.description: Preview the live Token Risk 402 challenge without paying.

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC Token Risk analysis for Solana or Base.

tools.name: token_security
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC Solana Token Security analysis.

environment.name: BENTCRYPTO_ALLOW_PAYMENTS
environment.description: Must equal YES before paid tools may sign

environment.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environment.description: Dedicated Base payment wallet private key

environment.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environment.description: Dedicated Solana payment wallet private key
